title: Tyler's constant interest in time travel

tellings.quote: because when I knew Tyler he was always he was always talking about time travel

plain: A man known only as Tyler was, through the 2010s, constantly talking about time travel. The religious studies professor Diana Pasulka, who writes about belief in UFOs, says this from knowing him personally: "when I knew Tyler he was always he was always talking about time travel," a detail she raises because it may hint at what he was really working on.
